description: This file defines the 'Install' controller class for the startup process in the OpenCart installation system. It initializes key components such as document, URL, and language settings during installation.

classes.name: Install
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing the installation startup process, setting up language, document, and URL components.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes document, URL, and language components during the installation process, based on request parameters and available languages.
